name: Node.js (direct official archive)
description: Install one pinned Node.js runtime with npm/npx and SHA256 verification, without version managers or Corepack.

version.description: Exact Node.js release version; latest/lts and major-only selectors are not supported.

sha256Amd64.description: SHA256 of the official linux-x64.tar.xz archive for the selected release.

sha256Arm64.description: SHA256 of the official linux-arm64.tar.xz archive for the selected release.
